question: What was the Sacrament of Anointing of the Sick formerly called?

teaching.title: Anointing of the Sick / Extreme Unction
teaching.body: The sacrament was long called 'Extreme Unction' (final anointing), which gave the impression it was reserved only for the dying. Vatican II and the 1972 rite renamed it 'Anointing of the Sick' to emphasize it is for anyone 'who begins to be in danger of death from sickness or old age.' James 5:14-15 is the key scriptural basis. The sacrament forgives sin, strengthens the soul, and may restore physical health if God wills it.
